page.notes: Drop cap "A" joined to "Ccepi" as printed. Catchword "ga te" printed with a space. The short line "Cum" at the end of its line is clear enough but the tilde over the u may be a stain. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphen.
